summary: Second-pass reduction of the chapter toward the 2100-word target. Cuts fall mostly on optional apparatus: the telescope image, transport specifics, Branly/X-ray elaboration, the St. Gaudens character list and the chemist's framing sentence. Trims are spread across long paragraphs. All eight protected excerpts and the essential chain of argument (Chicago 1893, Langley, the dynamo prayer, the sequences, 310, rays into faith, sex as strength, Gibbon at Amiens, force versus taste, Chartres, Cherbourg) are retained.
